newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, nine more due.
newsitem.headline: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, nine more due.

text.p: Four ships are loading a total of 74,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat is for export to Italy, Morocco and Turkey, they said.
Two ships are loading 25,000 tonnes of barley at Rouen for export to Saudi Arabia and France's Reunion Island terrritory.
Nine more ships are expected in port by February 14 to load 120,000 tonnes of wheat to unspecified destinations.
